headline: A Private Agent Builds the Job Hunt
lede: This local Claude Code framework turns a job search into an engineered pipeline: scrape listings, rank fit, draft tailored materials, and prepare for interviews. Human review remains in the loop while personal records stay on the applicant’s machine.

headline: Security Audits Gain an Adversarial Second Pass
lede: Cloudflare’s coding-agent skill divides an audit into reconnaissance, hunting, verification, and structured reporting. Independent agents challenge each finding, while JSON ledgers preserve coverage, evidence, and unresolved leads across repeated runs.

headline: Orca Turns Coding Agents Into a Workbench
lede: Orca gives teams one workspace for parallel agents, isolated Git worktrees, remote SSH sessions, diffs, issues, and mobile oversight. Its operational focus is simple: run several experiments at once, compare the results, and merge deliberately.

headline: Ponytail Makes Less Code the Default
lede: Ponytail instructs coding agents to exhaust native features, standard libraries, and existing project code before adding machinery. The resulting discipline targets lower latency, fewer dependencies, and smaller maintenance surfaces without discarding safety or accessibility.

headline: ComfyUI Builds Media Pipelines by Connecting Nodes
lede: ComfyUI turns image, video, audio, 3D, and text generation into a manipulable graph of models and processing steps. Save the workflow, rerun only the changed branch, and move the same visual recipe from an artist’s desktop into an application.

headline: Ruflo Assembles an Operating System for Agents
lede: Ruflo places a Rust execution engine beneath swarms of specialized agents, persistent memory, workers, and federated communication. It is built for long-running engineering workflows where routing, state, and secure coordination matter as much as the model call.

headline: Graphify Maps the Hidden Structure of a Codebase
lede: Graphify combines deterministic syntax and call-graph extraction with model-assisted reading of documents, diagrams, screenshots, and schemas. Its labeled edges distinguish what was extracted from what was inferred, producing a local, incrementally updated map for humans and agents.

headline: OpenCode Crosses 219,000 Stars
lede: OpenCode brings task-oriented coding assistance to both the terminal and desktop, with separate build and planning modes. Explicit command permissions and guarded file edits keep its autonomous capabilities bounded while developers explore unfamiliar repositories or automate routine work.

headline: A Cabinet of Agents for Every Department
lede: Agency Agents catalogs reusable professional roles as structured Markdown profiles, from frontend engineering and technical writing to incident response and data remediation. Installation scripts and a desktop browser make the collection portable across today’s major coding-agent tools.

headline: Headroom Compresses Context Before It Costs You
lede: Headroom keeps tool outputs, logs, source files, and retrieval results local while reducing the tokens sent to an LLM. Specialized compressors, cache-aware routing, and recoverable originals lower context pressure without surrendering access to the full record.
